plan: Drive: from Germansen Landing, about 187 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 57.05424, -125.08441, pull off on Finlay FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 6.4 km NE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 101 m, about 137 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 40 m W of the spot at 721 m (57.10052, -125.0241). Water: unnamed wetland 20 m NE (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-41, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2024-07-09, closures 2026-10-16.
